When modifying existing apps, look for these patterns and migrate to platform services.
Each one deletes app code rather than adding it:

- **Scheduling (Server-Side Cron)**: Client-side polling (`setInterval` + `exec`/`fetch`) → `cron.schedule` + `Bridge.on('cron:result')`.
- **Jobs (Long-Running Operations)**: Hand-rolled in-memory job tracking (`activeScans`-style maps + polling status routes) → `ctx.jobs.start()` + frontend `jobs.list`/`jobs.cancel` + `Bridge.subscribe('job:update')`.
- **AI**: Custom AI retry/backoff loops → the built-in `retries: N` param. `exec` + `claude -p` → `ai.prompt`. Hand-rolled per-user op counters as spend proxies → `meterKey` on `ai.prompt` + `ai.usage` (real token/cost accounting).
- **Database (Platform MariaDB)**: Growing data in `state.*` (arrays/collections) → DB tables via `ctx.dbQuery`. Never install `mariadb`/`mysql2`.
- **App Settings**: Hand-rolled GET/POST `/api/config` routes backed by a config file or state keys → `settings.get/set/all` / `ctx.settings`.
- **Files & Uploads**: Base64-decode + `fs.write` upload handlers and manual Range-header streaming → `ctx.files.saveBase64()` / `ctx.files.serve()`.
- **Notifications**: In-app toasts only visible inside the iframe → `showToast()` / `toast.show`. Replace legacy `notify` calls with `toast.show`.
- **Dialogs & Modals**: Custom modal/backdrop markup and `window.confirm`/`window.prompt` → `showConfirm()`/`showModal()`, or `<vc-dialog>` when the dialog must host `vc-*` components or voice input.
- **Receiving Events**: Hand-rolled SSE client sets (headers, ping interval, cleanup) → `ctx.sse.handler()` / `ctx.sse.emit()`. Polling another app's state or DB to react to it → `ctx.events.subscribe('<app>:*', handler)` on the platform bus.
- **UI Components (`vc-*`)**: Hand-rolled reusable widgets → the platform components: input+send bar → `<vc-input-bar>`; message thread → `<vc-chat-log>`; progress-bar div → `<vc-progress>`; empty-state block → `<vc-empty-state>`; model `<select>` from `ai.models` (and its `state.*`/`settings.*` glue) → `<vc-model-picker>` + `persist-key`; in-iframe modal panel with header/×/footer → `<vc-dialog>`; canvas image zoomer or `<img>`/`<video>` lightbox → `<vc-media-viewer>`; markdown/`innerHTML` of AI output → `<vc-markdown>`; RAM/CPU/swap/disk gauges → `<vc-sysmon>`. Also delete app-local `escapeHtml`/`timeAgo`/`formatDate`/fetch wrappers and spinner/skeleton CSS — the runtime and theme provide them.
- **Artifacts**: A tool result that returns an absolute file path (or base64 of a large file) → `ctx.artifacts.put(file)` and return its `.link`.
- **Audio, Image & Translation**: Direct OpenAI Whisper/TTS, Gemini/DALL·E image, or Google/DeepL translation calls via `http.fetch` with an app-held key → `ai.transcribe` / `ai.tts` / `ai.image` / `ai.translate` / `ai.detect` (platform-managed keys). Remove the app's own key.
- **Maps & Routing**: Google Maps/Directions/Distance Matrix/Geocoding/Places called via `http.fetch` with an app-held key → `ai.route` / `ai.routeMatrix` / `ai.geocode` / `ai.places`. Remove the app's own Maps key.
- **Web Search**: A search API called via `http.fetch` with an app-held key → `ai.webSearch`.
- **Google Auth**: An app-implemented OAuth2 flow (token storage, refresh, redirect handling) → `auth.google.*`. Deletes hundreds of lines and shares scopes across apps.
- **Email Accounts + Email Engine**: Raw IMAP/SMTP (`imapflow`, `nodemailer`, `node-imap`) or direct Gmail API calls, and any app-run mail sync → the platform engine `email.*` / `ctx.email.*`. Bulk delete uses the array form `email.delete({ account, uids: [...] })`. Remove those deps and any app-stored IMAP/SMTP credentials.
- **Calendar Engine**: Direct Google Calendar API calls or app-run event polling → `calendar.*` / `ctx.calendar.*`.
- **Todos Engine**: App-local todo/reminder tables → the platform store `todos.*` / `ctx.todos.*`. `ctx.jobs` (background work an app runs) is NOT this.
- **App Licensing**: Hand-rolled licence-key validation, entitlement caching, or `http.fetch` calls to the licence server with an app-held secret → declare `manifest.auth.license` and read `ctx.license.entitlement()` / `me.license`.
- **Platform Cron**: For jobs that should drive your own HTTP endpoints, prefer `platform.cron.schedule()` with an `app-api` target over a shell command.
- **System Monitor**: App-private host samplers (`/proc/meminfo` and `/proc/stat` readers, `statfsSync` polls, `os.freemem`/`os.cpus` timers) and client-side `setInterval` polls of an `/api/sys` route → `sysmon.subscribe()` once and listen for `sysmon:sample`. Hand-rolled RAM/CPU/swap/disk gauges → `<vc-sysmon>`, which also charts RAM and CPU history, draws a per-core strip, and lists the top memory consumers.
- **Printing**: App-private `lp` / `lpr` / `cupsd` shell-outs, `window.print()` buttons that need the browser's own printer, and e-mailing a PDF "to print" → `ctx.print.pdf({ pdf, title })` (gated by the owner in Setup → Drucker); show the button only when `status().available`.
- **Platform Approvals (Governance)**: App-local approval queues/cards (pending maps, approval-log tables, client-side approve execution) → `governance.propose` + rendering `governance.list`; an app-local record of what was approved per message → `governance.decisions`. NOTE: granting this capability makes the app an approval surface — `decide` lets app code approve proposals.
- **Spend & Permissions**: Hand-rolled per-user budget checks against `ai.usage` totals → let the platform enforce: the admin sets caps per app / per user in App Config → Spend; read `spend.status` to show a balance and catch `err.code === "E_NO_CREDITS"` to degrade gracefully.
